assumptions_metadata.task_description: Compute final result strings and update season standings for an IPL analytics platform using the matches table.

assumptions.assumption: team1 and team2 must be different teams.
If result is 'runs' or 'wickets', winner must be either team1 or team2.
If result is 'no result', winner must be null.
If result is 'tie', super_over must be 'Y'.
If super_over is 'Y', winner must be either team1 or team2.
result must be one of {'runs','wickets','tie','no result'}.
When result is 'wickets', result_margin must be an integer between 1 and 10.
When result is 'runs', result_margin must be an integer between 1 and 250.
When result is 'tie' or 'no result', result_margin must be null.
At least 90% of matches have result in {'runs','wickets'}.
target_overs must be > 0 and <= 20.0.
target_runs must be between 1 and 300.
If method is 'D/L', target_overs must be < 20.0.
If method is 'D/L', target_runs and target_overs must be non-null.
Among rows where method is null, at least 95% should have target_overs = 20.0.
toss_winner must be either team1 or team2.
toss_decision must be one of {'bat','field'}.
At least 60% of matches have toss_decision = 'field'.
toss_winner must be non-null.
id must be unique across matches.
date must be a valid ISO date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
The calendar year extracted from date must equal the integer value of season.
season must be between 2008 and 2024 inclusive.
If result is 'no result', player_of_match must be null.
If result is not 'no result', player_of_match must be non-null.
For matches with result in {'runs','wickets','tie'}, at least 99% have player_of_match non-null.

result.code:
import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

VALID_RESULTS = {"runs", "wickets", "tie", "no result"}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_fp = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_fp, keep_default_na=True, na_values=['NullValue'])

    df['season'] = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce')
    df['result_margin'] = pd.to_numeric(df['result_margin'], errors='coerce')
    df['target_runs'] = pd.to_numeric(df['target_runs'], errors='coerce')
    df['target_overs'] = pd.to_numeric(df['target_overs'], errors='coerce')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['id'].is_unique
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    date_ok = df['date'].notna().all()
    season_ok = df['season'].notna().all()
    season_range_ok = ((df['season'] >= 2008) & (df['season'] <= 2024)).all()
    season_matches_year = (df['date'].dt.year == df['season'].astype(int)).all()
    assert date_ok and season_ok and season_range_ok and season_matches_year
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    toss_winner_non_null = df['toss_winner'].notna().all()
    toss_winner_in_pair = ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
    toss_decision_allowed = df['toss_decision'].isin({'bat', 'field'}).all()
    field_ratio = (df['toss_decision'] == 'field').mean()
    assert toss_winner_non_null and toss_winner_in_pair and toss_decision_allowed and (field_ratio >= 0.60)
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['bat_first_team'] = np.where(
        df['toss_decision'] == 'bat',
        df['toss_winner'],
        np.where(df['toss_winner'] == df['team1'], df['team2'], df['team1'])
    )

    # ASSERTION_START
    result_allowed = df['result'].isin(VALID_RESULTS).all()
    decided_mask = df['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets'])
    winner_in_pair = ((df['winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['winner'] == df['team2']))
    decided_winner_ok = winner_in_pair[decided_mask].all()
    nores_mask = df['result'] == 'no result'
    nores_winner_null = df.loc[nores_mask, 'winner'].isna().all()
    tie_mask = df['result'] == 'tie'
    tie_super_over_ok = (df.loc[tie_mask, 'super_over'] == 'Y').all()
    tie_winner_ok = winner_in_pair[tie_mask].all()
    super_over_winner_ok = winner_in_pair[df['super_over'] == 'Y'].all()
    assert result_allowed and decided_winner_ok and nores_winner_null and tie_super_over_ok and tie_winner_ok and super_over_winner_ok
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    wkts_mask = df['result'] == 'wickets'
    runs_mask = df['result'] == 'runs'
    tie_or_nores_mask = df['result'].isin(['tie', 'no result'])
    wkts_vals = df.loc[wkts_mask, 'result_margin']
    runs_vals = df.loc[runs_mask, 'result_margin']
    wkts_int_range = wkts_vals.notna().all() and ((wkts_vals >= 1) & (wkts_vals <= 10) & (np.floor(wkts_vals) == wkts_vals)).all()
    runs_int_range = runs_vals.notna().all() and ((runs_vals >= 1) & (runs_vals <= 250) & (np.floor(runs_vals) == runs_vals)).all()
    tie_nores_null = df.loc[tie_or_nores_mask, 'result_margin'].isna().all()
    major_result_ratio = df['result'].isin({'runs','wickets'}).mean()
    assert wkts_int_range and runs_int_range and tie_nores_null and (major_result_ratio >= 0.90)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    nonnull_to = df['target_overs'].notna()
    nonnull_tr = df['target_runs'].notna()
    bounds_to_ok = ((df.loc[nonnull_to, 'target_overs'] > 0) & (df.loc[nonnull_to, 'target_overs'] <= 20.0)).all()
    bounds_tr_ok = ((df.loc[nonnull_tr, 'target_runs'] >= 1) & (df.loc[nonnull_tr, 'target_runs'] <= 300)).all()
    dl_mask = df['method'] == 'D/L'
    dl_to_ok = df.loc[dl_mask, 'target_overs'].notna().all() and (df.loc[dl_mask, 'target_overs'] < 20.0).all()
    dl_tr_ok = df.loc[dl_mask, 'target_runs'].notna().all()
    null_method_mask = df['method'].isna()
    null_method_full_overs_ratio = (df.loc[null_method_mask, 'target_overs'] == 20.0).mean()
    assert bounds_to_ok and bounds_tr_ok and dl_to_ok and dl_tr_ok and (null_method_full_overs_ratio >= 0.95)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    nores_mask = df['result'] == 'no result'
    pom_non_nores_ok = df.loc[~nores_mask, 'player_of_match'].notna().all()
    pom_nores_null = df.loc[nores_mask, 'player_of_match'].isna().all()
    played_mask = df['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets', 'tie'])
    pom_played_ratio = df.loc[played_mask, 'player_of_match'].notna().mean()
    assert pom_non_nores_ok and pom_nores_null and (pom_played_ratio >= 0.99)
    # ASSERTION_END

    def build_result_string(row: pd.Series) -> str:
        r = row['result']
        if r == 'no result':
            return f"No result - {row['team1']} vs {row['team2']}"
        w = row['winner']
        opp = row['team2'] if w == row['team1'] else row['team1']
        if r == 'runs':
            m = int(row['result_margin'])
            base = f"{w} beat {opp} by {m} runs"
        elif r == 'wickets':
            m = int(row['result_margin'])
            base = f"{w} beat {opp} by {m} wickets"
        elif r == 'tie':
            base = f"Tied - Super Over: {w}"
        else:
            base = r
        if row['method'] == 'D/L':
            tr = int(row['target_runs']) if pd.notna(row['target_runs']) else None
            to = float(row['target_overs']) if pd.notna(row['target_overs']) else None
            base = f"{base} (DLS: target {tr} in {to} overs)"
        if pd.notna(row['player_of_match']):
            base = f"{base} | Player of Match: {row['player_of_match']}"
        return base

    df['final_result'] = df.apply(build_result_string, axis=1)

    season_cols = ['season', 'team1', 'team2', 'result', 'super_over', 'winner']
    base = df[season_cols].copy()

    team_entries = pd.concat([
        base.rename(columns={'team1': 'team'})[['season', 'team', 'team2', 'result', 'super_over', 'winner']].rename(columns={'team2': 'opponent'}),
        base.rename(columns={'team2': 'team'})[['season', 'team1', 'result', 'super_over', 'winner']].rename(columns={'team1': 'opponent'})
    ], ignore_index=True)

    team_entries['is_winner'] = team_entries['team'] == team_entries['winner']
    team_entries['is_decided'] = team_entries['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets']) | ((team_entries['result'] == 'tie') & (team_entries['super_over'] == 'Y'))
    team_entries['is_loser'] = (~team_entries['is_winner']) & team_entries['is_decided']
    team_entries['is_noresult'] = team_entries['result'] == 'no result'

    team_entries['wins'] = team_entries['is_winner'].astype(int)
    team_entries['losses'] = team_entries['is_loser'].astype(int)
    team_entries['no_results'] = team_entries['is_noresult'].astype(int)
    team_entries['matches'] = 1

    team_entries['points'] = np.where(
        team_entries['is_winner'], 2,
        np.where(team_entries['is_noresult'] | ((team_entries['result'] == 'tie') & (team_entries['super_over'] != 'Y')), 1, 0)
    )

    standings = (
        team_entries.groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)[['matches', 'wins', 'losses', 'no_results', 'points']].sum()
        .sort_values(['season', 'points', 'wins', 'team'], ascending=[True, False, False, True])
    )

    final_results_out = df[['id', 'season', 'date', 'team1', 'team2', 'final_result', 'toss_winner', 'toss_decision', 'bat_first_team', 'winner', 'result', 'result_margin', 'super_over', 'method', 'target_runs', 'target_overs', 'player_of_match']].copy()

    final_results_out.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'final_results.csv'), index=False)
    standings.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'season_standings.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

VALID_RESULTS = {"runs", "wickets", "tie", "no result"}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_fp = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_fp, keep_default_na=True, na_values=['NullValue'])

    df['season'] = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce')
    df['result_margin'] = pd.to_numeric(df['result_margin'], errors='coerce')
    df['target_runs'] = pd.to_numeric(df['target_runs'], errors='coerce')
    df['target_overs'] = pd.to_numeric(df['target_overs'], errors='coerce')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['id'].is_unique
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    date_ok = df['date'].notna().all()
    season_ok = df['season'].notna().all()
    season_range_ok = ((df['season'] >= 2008) & (df['season'] <= 2024)).all()
    season_matches_year = (df['date'].dt.year == df['season'].astype(int)).all()
    assert date_ok and season_ok and season_range_ok and season_matches_year
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    toss_winner_non_null = df['toss_winner'].notna().all()
    toss_winner_in_pair = ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
    toss_decision_allowed = df['toss_decision'].isin({'bat', 'field'}).all()
    field_ratio = (df['toss_decision'] == 'field').mean()
    assert toss_winner_non_null and toss_winner_in_pair and toss_decision_allowed and (field_ratio >= 0.60)
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['bat_first_team'] = np.where(
        df['toss_decision'] == 'bat',
        df['toss_winner'],
        np.where(df['toss_winner'] == df['team1'], df['team2'], df['team1'])
    )

    # ASSERTION_START
    result_allowed = df['result'].isin(VALID_RESULTS).all()
    decided_mask = df['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets'])
    winner_in_pair = ((df['winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['winner'] == df['team2']))
    decided_winner_ok = winner_in_pair[decided_mask].all()
    nores_mask = df['result'] == 'no result'
    nores_winner_null = df.loc[nores_mask, 'winner'].isna().all()
    tie_mask = df['result'] == 'tie'
    tie_super_over_ok = (df.loc[tie_mask, 'super_over'] == 'Y').all()
    tie_winner_ok = winner_in_pair[tie_mask].all()
    super_over_winner_ok = winner_in_pair[df['super_over'] == 'Y'].all()
    assert result_allowed and decided_winner_ok and nores_winner_null and tie_super_over_ok and tie_winner_ok and super_over_winner_ok
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    wkts_mask = df['result'] == 'wickets'
    runs_mask = df['result'] == 'runs'
    tie_or_nores_mask = df['result'].isin(['tie', 'no result'])
    wkts_vals = df.loc[wkts_mask, 'result_margin']
    runs_vals = df.loc[runs_mask, 'result_margin']
    wkts_int_range = wkts_vals.notna().all() and ((wkts_vals >= 1) & (wkts_vals <= 10) & (np.floor(wkts_vals) == wkts_vals)).all()
    runs_int_range = runs_vals.notna().all() and ((runs_vals >= 1) & (runs_vals <= 250) & (np.floor(runs_vals) == runs_vals)).all()
    tie_nores_null = df.loc[tie_or_nores_mask, 'result_margin'].isna().all()
    major_result_ratio = df['result'].isin({'runs','wickets'}).mean()
    assert wkts_int_range and runs_int_range and tie_nores_null and (major_result_ratio >= 0.90)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    nonnull_to = df['target_overs'].notna()
    nonnull_tr = df['target_runs'].notna()
    bounds_to_ok = ((df.loc[nonnull_to, 'target_overs'] > 0) & (df.loc[nonnull_to, 'target_overs'] <= 20.0)).all()
    bounds_tr_ok = ((df.loc[nonnull_tr, 'target_runs'] >= 1) & (df.loc[nonnull_tr, 'target_runs'] <= 300)).all()
    dl_mask = df['method'] == 'D/L'
    dl_to_ok = df.loc[dl_mask, 'target_overs'].notna().all() and (df.loc[dl_mask, 'target_overs'] < 20.0).all()
    dl_tr_ok = df.loc[dl_mask, 'target_runs'].notna().all()
    null_method_mask = df['method'].isna()
    null_method_full_overs_ratio = (df.loc[null_method_mask, 'target_overs'] == 20.0).mean()
    assert bounds_to_ok and bounds_tr_ok and dl_to_ok and dl_tr_ok and (null_method_full_overs_ratio >= 0.95)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    nores_mask = df['result'] == 'no result'
    pom_non_nores_ok = df.loc[~nores_mask, 'player_of_match'].notna().all()
    pom_nores_null = df.loc[nores_mask, 'player_of_match'].isna().all()
    played_mask = df['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets', 'tie'])
    pom_played_ratio = df.loc[played_mask, 'player_of_match'].notna().mean()
    assert pom_non_nores_ok and pom_nores_null and (pom_played_ratio >= 0.99)
    # ASSERTION_END

    def build_result_string(row: pd.Series) -> str:
        r = row['result']
        if r == 'no result':
            return f"No result - {row['team1']} vs {row['team2']}"
        w = row['winner']
        opp = row['team2'] if w == row['team1'] else row['team1']
        if r == 'runs':
            m = int(row['result_margin'])
            base = f"{w} beat {opp} by {m} runs"
        elif r == 'wickets':
            m = int(row['result_margin'])
            base = f"{w} beat {opp} by {m} wickets"
        elif r == 'tie':
            base = f"Tied - Super Over: {w}"
        else:
            base = r
        if row['method'] == 'D/L':
            tr = int(row['target_runs']) if pd.notna(row['target_runs']) else None
            to = float(row['target_overs']) if pd.notna(row['target_overs']) else None
            base = f"{base} (DLS: target {tr} in {to} overs)"
        if pd.notna(row['player_of_match']):
            base = f"{base} | Player of Match: {row['player_of_match']}"
        return base

    df['final_result'] = df.apply(build_result_string, axis=1)

    season_cols = ['season', 'team1', 'team2', 'result', 'super_over', 'winner']
    base = df[season_cols].copy()

    team_entries = pd.concat([
        base.rename(columns={'team1': 'team'})[['season', 'team', 'team2', 'result', 'super_over', 'winner']].rename(columns={'team2': 'opponent'}),
        base.rename(columns={'team2': 'team'})[['season', 'team1', 'result', 'super_over', 'winner']].rename(columns={'team1': 'opponent'})
    ], ignore_index=True)

    team_entries['is_winner'] = team_entries['team'] == team_entries['winner']
    team_entries['is_decided'] = team_entries['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets']) | ((team_entries['result'] == 'tie') & (team_entries['super_over'] == 'Y'))
    team_entries['is_loser'] = (~team_entries['is_winner']) & team_entries['is_decided']
    team_entries['is_noresult'] = team_entries['result'] == 'no result'

    team_entries['wins'] = team_entries['is_winner'].astype(int)
    team_entries['losses'] = team_entries['is_loser'].astype(int)
    team_entries['no_results'] = team_entries['is_noresult'].astype(int)
    team_entries['matches'] = 1

    team_entries['points'] = np.where(
        team_entries['is_winner'], 2,
        np.where(team_entries['is_noresult'] | ((team_entries['result'] == 'tie') & (team_entries['super_over'] != 'Y')), 1, 0)
    )

    standings = (
        team_entries.groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)[['matches', 'wins', 'losses', 'no_results', 'points']].sum()
        .sort_values(['season', 'points', 'wins', 'team'], ascending=[True, False, False, True])
    )

    final_results_out = df[['id', 'season', 'date', 'team1', 'team2', 'final_result', 'toss_winner', 'toss_decision', 'bat_first_team', 'winner', 'result', 'result_margin', 'super_over', 'method', 'target_runs', 'target_overs', 'player_of_match']].copy()

    final_results_out.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'final_results.csv'), index=False)
    standings.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'season_standings.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
